candidates: When a PR mixes a non-visual bug fix with a visual theme-variable change, split them into separate PRs. In this project, any change that alters rendered output triggers visual regression tests that require a mermaid-js admin to approve the merge; non-visual changes (e.g. fixing a DOM attribute bug, adding an identifier attribute) can be merged without that gate.

When modifying a shared theme variable default in any of the theme files (`theme-base.js`, `theme-default.js`, `theme-dark.js`, `theme-forest.js`, `theme-neutral.js`), verify the rendered appearance across all five built-in themes (default, neutral, dark, forest, base) before requesting review, since a single variable change can affect each theme differently.
